name: HVAC
description: Heating, air conditioning, ventilation, rooms too hot or too cold, thermostat problems, drafts, odd smells from vents.

name: Plumbing
description: Leaks, clogged or overflowing toilets and sinks, no hot water, dripping taps, water on the floor.

name: Electrical & Lighting
description: Lights out or flickering, dead power outlets, tripped breakers, no power to an area.

name: Cleaning & Janitorial
description: Spills, rubbish not collected, restroom supplies, dirty kitchens or meeting rooms, pests.

name: Furniture
description: Broken chairs or desks, sit-stand desk faults, requests for new or extra furniture, ergonomic equipment.

name: Doors, Locks & Keys
description: Doors that won't close or lock, broken handles, key or lock change requests.

name: General Maintenance
description: Building repairs that fit no other facilities category: walls, ceilings, flooring, windows, blinds.

name: Moves, Adds & Changes
description: Moving a person or team to a different desk or office, new starter seating, leaver desk clean-up.

name: Room Setup
description: Arranging a room or event space: table layouts, extra chairs, catering setup.

name: Mail & Shipping
description: Missing or misdelivered mail or parcels, courier pickups, outgoing shipments.

name: Security & Access Badges
description: Badge not working, new or replacement badge, access to a restricted area, security concerns.

name: Parking
description: Parking permits, parking space allocation, problems in the car park.
